title: Parity of circuit values
statement: For a Boolean assignment $x$ to the $n$ variables and a finite list of pairs $(C_i,D_i)$ of Boolean circuit trees, define the result to be the exclusive OR of the values of the first circuits $C_i$, evaluated at $x$, with the empty list giving false.
